Title: General availability: Azure Monitor Query SDK

Body.Content:
We are announcing the general availability of the Azure Monitor Query SDK for .NET, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python.

This new SDK allows developers to build applications that perform read-only queries in Azure Monitor's Logs and Metrics platform, so they can analyze and display data in custom ways. The SDK has been modernized to follow the Azure SDK guidelines and be idiomatic for each programming language. Additionally, it introduces a number of updates and new features.

Read the announcement blog post for more details and to get started.
